# BTCDecoded (Bitcoin Decoded)

> Marketing and operator entry point for BLVM: verified downloads, plug-and-play installs, and learning paths into Bitcoin Commons.

BTCDecoded is the **reference implementation** brand for [Bitcoin Commons](https://thebitcoincommons.org). This site targets **operators and newcomers** choosing a node and downloading verified **`blvm`** binaries. Normative consensus specification lives on thebitcoincommons.org; APIs, configuration, and verification methodology live on docs.thebitcoincommons.org.

**Two learning paths:** Developers start at Problem → Architecture → Orange Paper → Governance. Node operators start at Why BLVM → Pre-Built Nodes → Install → FAQ.

## Downloads (canonical on this site)

- [Install BLVM](https://btcdecoded.org/install/): Current release packages, checksums, Docker commands, release history (version data from GitHub Releases)
- [Pre-built nodes](https://btcdecoded.org/plugandplay/): Start9, Umbrel, myNode, and Parmanode marketplace install paths

## Learning paths

### Developers

- [Problem](https://btcdecoded.org/problem/): Informal governance risk and the need for a shared mathematical spec
- [Architecture](https://btcdecoded.org/architecture/): BLVM crate map and dependency flow into consensus and node layers
- [Orange Paper (on-site intro)](https://btcdecoded.org/orangepaper/): Orientation and formal-proof overview; canonical math IR is off-site
- [Governance](https://btcdecoded.org/governance/): Live YAML viewer, tiers, and Commons enforcement model

### Node operators

- [Why BLVM?](https://btcdecoded.org/whyblvm/): One spec, Z3-backed verification, differential testing against Bitcoin Core
- [FAQ](https://btcdecoded.org/faq/): Consensus safety, decentralization, support, and governance basics

## Normative specification (off-site)

- [Orange Paper (canonical)](https://thebitcoincommons.org/orange-paper.html): Mathematical Bitcoin consensus IR (not generated from code)
- [Consensus Spec register](https://thebitcoincommons.org/spec.html): Auditable rule register with visualizations

## Technical documentation

- [BLVM documentation book](https://docs.thebitcoincommons.org/introduction.html): Operators, developers, node config, SDK, security posture
- [Book llms.txt](https://docs.thebitcoincommons.org/llms.txt): Machine-readable chapter index for the docs site
- [Commons llms.txt](https://thebitcoincommons.org/llms.txt): Parent project machine-readable index

## Implementation

- [blvm releases](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm/releases): Source of truth for install page version metadata
- [blvm repository](https://github.com/BTCDecoded/blvm): Reference node CLI and release artifacts

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://btcdecoded.org/): Latest release banner and project overview
- [robots.txt](https://btcdecoded.org/robots.txt): Crawler policy (not access control)
- [Bitcoin Commons](https://thebitcoincommons.org/): Umbrella project and spec hosting
- [Updates](https://btccommons.substack.com/): Release notes and project newsletter
- [Security contact](mailto:security@thebitcoincommons.org): Vulnerability reports
